001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketConditionAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketImmigrationModifier;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.population.PopulationComposition;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
013
014
015
016public class FreeMarket extends BaseMarketConditionPlugin implements MarketImmigrationModifier {
017
018        public static float OFFICER_MERC_PROB_MOD = 0.25f;
019        
020        public static float MIN_STABILITY_PENALTY = 1f;
021        public static float MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY = 3f;
022        //public static float STABILITY_PENALTY = 3f;
023        
024        public static float MIN_ACCESS_BONUS = 0.05f;
025        public static float MAX_ACCESS_BONUS = 0.25f;
026        
027        public static float MIN_GROWTH = 3f;
028        public static float MAX_GROWTH = 10f;
029        public static float MAX_DAYS = 365f;
030
031        public static FreeMarket get(MarketAPI market) {
032                MarketConditionAPI mc = market.getCondition(Conditions.FREE_PORT);
033                if (mc != null && mc.getPlugin() instanceof FreeMarket) {
034                        return (FreeMarket) mc.getPlugin();
035                }
036                return null;
037        }
038        
039        private float daysActive = 0f;
040        @Override
041        public void advance(float amount) {
042                if (!market.hasSpaceport()) {
043                        market.removeSpecificCondition(condition.getIdForPluginModifications());
044                        market.setFreePort(false);
045                        return;
046                }
047                if (amount <= 0) return;
048                if (Global.getSector().isPaused()) return;
049                
050                super.advance(amount);
051                
052                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
053                daysActive += days;
054        }
055        
056        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
057                return true;
058        }
059        
060        public float getDaysActive() {
061                return daysActive;
062        }
063        
064        public void setDaysActive(float daysActive) {
065                this.daysActive = daysActive;
066        }
067
068        public void apply(String id) {
069                market.addTransientImmigrationModifier(this);
070                
071                market.getAccessibilityMod().modifyFlat(id, getAccessBonus(), "Free port");
072                market.getStability().modifyFlat(id, -getStabilityPenalty(), "Free port");
073                
074                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_IS_MERC_PROB_MOD).modifyFlat(id, OFFICER_MERC_PROB_MOD);
075        }
076        
077        @Override
078        public boolean isTransient() {
079                return false;
080        }
081
082        public void unapply(String id) {
083                market.removeTransientImmigrationModifier(this);
084                
085                market.getStability().unmodifyFlat(id);
086                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(id);
087                
088                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_IS_MERC_PROB_MOD).unmodifyFlat(id);
089        }
090
091        public void modifyIncoming(MarketAPI market, PopulationComposition incoming) {
092                incoming.add(Factions.PIRATES, 5f);
093                incoming.add(Factions.POOR, 5f);
094                incoming.add(Factions.INDEPENDENT, 5f);
095                incoming.getWeight().modifyFlat(getModId(), getImmigrationBonus(), Misc.ucFirst(condition.getName().toLowerCase()));
096        }
097        
098        protected float getImmigrationBonus() {
099                //float growth = Math.min(1f, daysActive / 10f) * MAX_GROWTH;
100                float growth = MIN_GROWTH + daysActive / MAX_DAYS * (MAX_GROWTH - MIN_GROWTH);
101                growth = Math.round(growth);
102                if (growth > MAX_GROWTH) growth = MAX_GROWTH;
103                if (growth < 1) growth = 1;
104                return growth;
105        }
106        
107        protected float getAccessBonus() {
108                //float growth = Math.min(1f, daysActive / 10f) * MAX_GROWTH;
109                float access = MIN_ACCESS_BONUS + daysActive / MAX_DAYS * (MAX_ACCESS_BONUS - MIN_ACCESS_BONUS);
110                access = Math.round(access * 100f) / 100f;
111                if (access > MAX_ACCESS_BONUS) access = MAX_ACCESS_BONUS;
112                if (access < 0.01f) access = 0.01f;
113                return access;
114        }
115        
116        protected float getStabilityPenalty() {
117                //float growth = Math.min(1f, daysActive / 10f) * MAX_GROWTH;
118                float s = MIN_STABILITY_PENALTY + daysActive / MAX_DAYS * (MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY - MIN_STABILITY_PENALTY);
119                s = Math.round(s);
120                if (s > MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY) s = MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY;
121                if (s < 1f) s = 1f;
122                return s;
123        }
124        
125
126        protected void createTooltipAfterDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
127                super.createTooltipAfterDescription(tooltip, expanded);
128                
129                if (!market.hasSpaceport() && !Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
130                        tooltip.addPara("Requires a spaceport to have any effect", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 10f);
131                        return;
132                }
133                
134                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
135                        tooltip.addPara("Reduced stability (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)", 
136                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
137                                        "-" + (int) (MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY),
138                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
139                        tooltip.addPara("Increased population growth (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)",
140                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
141                                        "+" + (int) (MAX_GROWTH),
142                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
143                        
144                        tooltip.addPara("Increased accessibility (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)", 
145                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
146                                        "+" + (int) Math.round(MAX_ACCESS_BONUS * 100f) + "%",
147                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
148                } else {
149                        tooltip.addPara("%s stability (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)", 
150                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
151                                        "-" + (int)getStabilityPenalty(),
152                                        "-" + (int) (MAX_STABILITY_PENALTY),
153                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
154                        tooltip.addPara("%s population growth (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)",
155                                        
156                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
157                                        "+" + (int) getImmigrationBonus(),
158                                        "+" + (int) (MAX_GROWTH),
159                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
160                        
161                        tooltip.addPara("%s accessibility (maximum of %s, reached after %s days)", 
162                                        10f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
163                                        "+" + (int) Math.round(getAccessBonus() * 100f) + "%",
164                                        "+" + (int) Math.round(MAX_ACCESS_BONUS * 100f) + "%",
165                                        "" + (int) MAX_DAYS);
166                }
167                
168                tooltip.addPara("Colony does not require the transponder to be turned on for open trade. " +
169                                                "All commodities are legal to trade.", 10f);
170                
171                tooltip.addPara("Colony gets income from smuggled exports.", 10f);
172        }
173}
